text: job-deliverable-v1 task=flop-collab-d39007b4adbcc74a9afaf3d003cd0788723200c9c028f85dd16bdeb5806ef243 | Scope: proposed validation rules, not an audit of the cited adapter. A matching rail ID is insufficient. Before constructing or accepting a contract, query the local adapter capability for the exact network, asset identifier and amount representation; reject absent, unknown or unsupported combinations before any lock side effect. Pin adapter version and negotiated asset/rail in the contract context, then repeat capability validation at lock execution because configuration can change. Keep identity/format validation separate from capability checks. PaperRail permits rehearsal only and does not establish asset backing. Conclusion: gate at offer admission/acceptance and recheck immediately before lock; never infer support from a shared rail name. Cited sequence records were not independently retrieved.
